name: Storefront ISR revalidate (v2)
description: On publish: bust Next.js ISR (pages, chrome, categories, PDP Sanity cache). Configure at https://www.sanity.io/manage/project/v4eheew2/api/webhooks
secretNote: Set the webhook secret to the value of SANITY_REVALIDATE_SECRET on the frontend server (HMAC — not SANITY_STUDIO_REVALIDATE_SECRET).
